title: Project stalled and recovered in the run tick with one progress line per transition
action: In the run poll tick (run.rs ~1140-1197 and the loop that calls status_with_activity at ~1578): compute the D2 word. `stalled` = the activity record is older than mailbox::ACTIVITY_FRESHNESS_SECS AND process_info is Liveness::Alive; `recovered` = the first fresh read after a stalled one; otherwise the word status_with_activity already yields. Use mailbox::transition_status(bee_dir, job_id, word) from hcc-5 and, when it returns Some((from, to)), print exactly one progress line to the run stream (the same stream the tick's existing progress lines use): `herding: job <id> <to>` (e.g. `herding: job j1 stalled`, `herding: job j1 recovered`). `recovered` is followed by `working` on the next tick with no extra line. No new threshold number anywhere (D2). No behaviour change for dead panes (died path stays). Tests with FakeHerdr: alive + stale activity prints one stalled line, a second stale tick prints nothing, a fresh tick prints one recovered line, then silence.

truths: stalled needs both a stale activity file and a live pane process
one progress line per transition, none on repeat
